newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle not well tested - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle not well tested - USDA.

text.p: Trade was very slow early Monday in the Panhandle, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers were not well tested. Feedlots reporting moderate inquiry from buyers.
Sales reported on 500 slaughter steers and 200 heifers; 700 head confirmed for the week to date.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 70.00. Slaughter Heifers - Few Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1150 lbs 70.00.
